title: Staged global announcement playbook for blog, email, social and webinar
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Purpose: provide a single-source playbook for a staged, region-aware announcement across blog, email, social, and a customer webinar. This ticket coordinates message cadence, embargo windows, release notes publication, documentation sync, and runbooks for Support/Success. Scope excludes paid performance marketing (handled by Growth) and partner co-marketing assets (handled by Partnerships). Non-goals: single global blast without regional tailoring; anything requiring engineering feature changes outside patch releases.

risks: Regional publish windows may be blocked by legal/localization delays: mitigation = pre-translate core messages and set hard freeze times
High support volume post-launch could exceed initial expectations: mitigation = schedule on-call rotations and have templated responses ready
Docs or release notes miss an important upgrade note: mitigation = engineering sign-off + pre-publish checklist
Webinar technical failure: mitigation = dry runs, backup speaker, and recording contingency plan
decisions: Staged regional rollouts approved (EU -> NA -> APAC) to reduce simultaneous Support load and to respect local business hours
Release notes will live on docs.redwood.ai and be linked from the Console release banner within 30 minutes of blog publish
Webinar will be recorded and published as gated content; registrants receive recording and a follow-up how-to email

notes: Trade-offs considered: single global blast would maximize short-term reach but increase risk of support overload and legal/localization misses; staged approach increases coordination overhead but reduces operational risk.
Metrics to track post-launch: blog views, release notes views, webinar registrants/attendees, support ticket volume by hour, feature adoption in first 7 days.
Follow-up retrospective planned for 2026-03-27 to capture learnings and update the playbook.
